about: Step 6, temp book staging/sound.js (Mid's 35-sound.js): every piece, and what becomes of it. in v100: already home, nothing to bring. bring: Mid has it, v100 does not; it comes in as book entries and one law, never as Mid's code. cut: v100 does it another way; logged in Parked.md when Albert agrees.

SND: on/off and volume as getters over Mid's settings; v100's SOUND.toggle/on does on/off
saveSnd: saves Mid's settings; Saving is its own temp book
AC: sound.js: AC, master, NOISE, voices; panV becomes a pan argument
sndInit: two things v100 lacks: navigator.audioSession 'ambient' (the iPhone mute switch silences the game) and the limiter's knee 10, attack 0.005, release 0.25 (v100 sets threshold and ratio only); the numbers go in the Sound book
tone: sound.js: tone(), envelope shared as env()
SFX: 27 of 38 recipes are in the Sound book (HU, HW, HC, HA). 11 are not: shot, boom, pick, tribute, zeal, wind, hush, hooves, rumble, jingle, roar. Each comes with the feature that plays it (cannon, tribute, zeal, weather, events), as a book entry
CHAN: Sound book HX2 chan; the 11 above join it when they come
chanVol: three volumes (effects, alerts, ambience) set by the player; v100 has on/off only. A 'mix' entry in the Sound book and one slider row
sfx: sound.js: play(), heard through the event hook
camH: sound.js: camH(), law QAX; v100's is in metres, Mid's in units
hearing: sound.js: hearing(), law QAX; v100 also undoes the 41° squash
AMB: bird and cricket are in HX4; the wind (heard when it blows harder than 0.35) is not: it comes with the wind
ambience: the wind line, with the wind; Mid's bird also waits for a tree with wood left (v100 sings from any tree)
thunder: Mid makes a strike loud enough to carry the map (at least 4 × the floor, heard as if a quarter as far); v100's far thunder can fall silent. One number in HX1
APP: the native app's haptics (Apple's taptic engine through Capacitor); only when there is a native app
FEEL: three strengths (light, medium, heavy) for the native engine; v100's HX6 has milliseconds only, which iPhone Safari ignores
feltT: never felt more often than every 50 ms; v100 has no limit
onScreen: the hearing law keeps off-screen sounds quiet; Mid also felt only what is on screen: comes with feel
